title: Your package needs $1.72
scenario: You are expecting a package when a text says delivery failed because your address is incomplete. It asks for $1.72 to schedule redelivery and shows a tracking number that looks plausible.

answers.A: Open the retailer or carrier app/site you already use and check the tracking number there.
answers.B: Search the carrier independently and contact support with the tracking number.
answers.C: Pay the small fee because you are expecting a delivery and the amount is too small to be worth scamming.

explanation: Tiny fees are useful bait for collecting card and identity data. Expected deliveries make the story more believable, not more verified.
proTip: Small charge, potentially big data loss.
